name: dsh-codex-suite-workspace
description: Monorepo for DeepSeek Harness Codex Provider and Conversation UI plugins
author: jcy2387

scripts.pack: pnpm --filter @jcy2387/dsh-codex-provider pack && pnpm --filter @jcy2387/dsh-conversation-ui pack && pnpm --filter @jcy2387/dsh-suite pack
